workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've found the following possible 30-minute slots for the partners' meeting next week based on Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Could you please check which of these work for Elena and David?

Mon Nov 16: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
Tue Nov 17: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM
Wed Nov 18: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
Thu Nov 19: 10:00 AM
Fri Nov 20: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM

All times are Eastern. Let me know which one works for them. Thanks, Alison.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars and unfortunately none of the slots you suggested work for them.

I've found a new list of times where both Elena and David are free. Can you please check these against Priya's and Marcus's calendars?

Mon Nov 16: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM
Tue Nov 17: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
Wed Nov 18: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
Thu Nov 19: 9:30 AM, 2:30 PM, 3:00 PM

All times are Eastern. Let me know which one works. Thanks, Brad.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've checked your suggested times. Thursday at 2:30 PM and 3:00 PM both work. I've gone ahead and booked Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM Eastern for the partners' meeting. Please send the confirmation email to all four partners. Thanks, Alison.
